title: MoE模型预填充阶段减少专家对短答案F1的影响分析
summary: 研究发现，在MoE模型预填充阶段减少路由专家数量主要损害答案形式而非答案定位，敏感token集中在提示词两端（如聊天模板token或指令起始位置），保持这些位置使用全部专家可将F1损失控制在1分以内，首token延迟在11K提示下降低约14%。
summary_en: Reducing routed experts during MoE prefill mainly damages answer form rather than answer finding; sensitive tokens cluster at prompt ends (chat-template tokens or instruction start), and keeping those positions at full experts limits F1 loss to within one point while cutting time-to-first-token by ~14% on 11K-token prompts.
